President Trump expressed optimism Monday that the Iran war would end soon, but cautioned that the U.S. remains "locked and loaded" to resume military operations if necessary.   "Should there be any change with respect to developments in the Middle East, the United States of America is fully locked and loaded," he told reporters in the White House briefing room. "We don't think there's going to be any reason to use it, however."   "We're seeing momentum toward the end of this conflict," he added. "I think it's going to be ending fairly soon."   The president's comments come a day after Secretary of State Marco Rubio offered a less optimistic assessment of diplomatic efforts to end the more than eight-month war, saying negotiations with Iran had not been productive because of Tehran's demands.   "I wouldn't say we're at the verge of a breakthrough," Secretary Rubio told reporters Sunday.
